event_summary: An upright cyan rectangular prism on a circular base stays in the same location while its visible face width and its shadow on the wall change gradually.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a cyan upright rectangular prism standing on a round metallic-looking base on a tabletop in front of a wall. A large bright circular illumination area is visible on the wall, with a dark shadow of the prism and base crossing it. Across the video, the prism remains upright and in the same place on the base, while the visible cyan face and dark side edge change subtly. The wall shadow also changes shape and position slightly: the vertical part becomes narrower and shifts relative to the horizontal base shadow. The camera view remains fixed.

reasons: The upright prism, circular base, tabletop, wall, illumination patch, and shadow are visible from the first frame.
The object is already present and the gradual orientation/shadow change continues through the clip.
